candidates.title: Humanoid figure emerges from fog and abducts guard at Minuteman site
candidates.place_text: Minuteman missile site D5, D sector, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California
candidates.quote: uh next thing I know I see this shadow in the in the fog. I'm looking and I see the shadow and uh I see a a man which would appear to be a man or humanoid figure uh emerge from the fog, you know,

link.reason: Barth's own 1964 encounter with a humanoid at site D5, Vandenberg; no story holds this encounter.

candidates.title: Beings say they will not allow nuclear war
candidates.quote: Or communicating anything else is that they're not going to let it, you know, go to nuclear war. They needed to stop these missiles from launching.

link.reason: The beings' message that they will stop nuclear war, from Barth's encounter; no story holds this claim.

candidates.title: More than one non-human species, not all benevolent
candidates.quote: another thing uh that not every spec there were more than one species and there weren't all as benevolent as

link.reason: Barth's claim that there are several species and not all are benevolent; Greer's benevolent-alien theory is someone else's general theory, so it is a different story.

candidates.title: Memory floods back two weeks later; lost time
candidates.quote: paralyzed. I woke up and all of a sudden I got flooded with this whole experience that I just told you and it wasn't a dream.

link.reason: Barth's memory coming back two weeks after his encounter; Buchanan's memory returning 25 years later is a different person's experience.

candidates.title: Lost time from 2 a.m. to dawn; friend declines regression hypnosis
candidates.years_text: September 1964; about 20 years before the interview
candidates.quote: >> So there is a there's a gap. Now, what went on in that gap?

link.reason: The same lost-time gap after Barth's Vandenberg encounter that telling 4 describes.
link.difference: Puts the gap at 2 a.m. to dawn and adds that a friend declined regression hypnosis about 20 years later, crediting Lonnie and Robert Hastings.

candidates.title: Yellow orb tags along with Atlas launch
candidates.quote: Second stage took off. This or uh yellow orb came over and tracked the missile.

link.reason: Barth's yellow orb tracking an Atlas launch in May 1964; Sandler's Vandenberg footage is from the 1970s and shows discs, so it is a different event.

candidates.title: Bob Jacobs films UFO hitting a dummy warhead with beams
candidates.place_text: Big Sur telescope site / Vandenberg Air Force Base, California
candidates.quote: We could see clearly on film the nose cones separate and then we saw the dummy warhead and suddenly into that frame an object flew in [music] chasing the warhead and so on at the same speed

link.reason: Jacobs filming a UFO firing beams at the dummy warhead at Vandenberg/Big Sur in 1964.
link.difference: Told first hand by Jacobs himself, crediting Mansmann.

candidates.title: Government denies Robert Jacobs ever served
candidates.quote: They denied there was ever a Robert Jacobs in the Air Force. Then they in another inquiry, they denied there was ever a Robert Jacobs at Vandenberg Air Force Base.

link.reason: The government denying that Jacobs served in the Air Force or at Vandenberg.
link.difference: Told first hand, citing his DD214 and two separate denials (Air Force and Vandenberg).

candidates.title: Atlas launch scrubbed from the records
candidates.quote: There was no Atlas launch that day. Well, goddamn well there was because Robert found the found the files from Vanderberg using that particular that particular launch in detail.

link.reason: The claim that the September 1964 Atlas launch itself was erased from the records; the nearest story is about Jacobs' service being denied, not the launch.

candidates.title: Jacobs' mailbox blown up after threatening message
candidates.quote: fireworks in your mailbox at night. Oh, what a beautiful sight. You're going down, motherfucker." and my mailbox blew up.

link.reason: The threatening phone call and the mailbox blowing up at Jacobs' farm.
link.difference: Told first hand by Jacobs, quoting the threat in full.

candidates.title: Major Mansmann tracked down, admits supervising Jacobs
candidates.quote: And then Floren Mansman, his major, who his superior, eventually is tracked down by, I think, Bob Hastings and some other researchers and and in the 90s admits that he did manage Bob Jacobs.

link.reason: Both tell how Jacobs's service at Vandenberg was denied until his superior, Major Mansmann, later admitted that Jacobs had worked there. One of the story's tellings makes exactly this admission claim.
link.difference: Dates the admission to the 1990s and says Bob Hastings and other researchers tracked Mansmann down.

candidates.title: Malmstrom 1967: ten missiles go offline under red glowing object
candidates.place_text: Oscar Flight launch control center, Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana
candidates.quote: But I think even more relevant than Bob Salace who had an extremely interesting experience with 10 missiles shutting down at Malmstrin Air Force Base.

link.reason: Both tell of the 1967 shutdown of ten Malmstrom missiles under a red glowing object, credited to Salas and Jameson.
link.difference: Names Oscar Flight's launch control center and cites a Strategic Air Command write-up.

candidates.title: 1963 F8 Atlas missile tracked by a tagalong
candidates.quote: And in 1963, we have another example of an F8 Atlas missile being tracked by this sort of tag along. And it's even in the report.

link.reason: The nearest story is Barth's 1964 yellow orb tagging along with an Atlas launch. The host calls this 1963 case 'another example' and says it is in a report, so it is a different launch.

candidates.title: Five UAP incidents at Vandenberg, 2003-2005
candidates.quote: Between 2003 and 2005, five UAP incidents occurred at Vandenberg Air Force Base.

link.reason: This is a general claim covering five incidents from 2003 to 2005. The rectangular object of 2003 is a single incident that may fall within it.

candidates.title: Coast to Coast call drops at the lost-time question
candidates.quote: He wanted to know if I had had any lost time during the event and I was going to answer him and everything just went blank.

link.reason: No story covers Barth's Coast to Coast radio call that went blank at the lost-time question.

candidates.title: Bigfoot rumours in D sector
candidates.place_text: D sector, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California
candidates.quote: to scare the new guys was Bigfoot's out there and he's he's going to get you, but there was nothing about UFOs or even talk about it that I know.

link.reason: Barracks lore about Bigfoot in D sector is not in the corpus.

candidates.title: Zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks
candidates.place_text: park along a wash near Barth's home
candidates.quote: gave back to me and it goes it starts into a zigzag

link.reason: Barth's own zigzagging light during Fourth of July fireworks around 2000 is a different sighting from John Mills's 1993 zigzagging object near Malmstrom.

candidates.title: Metal BB blown out of nose
candidates.quote: uh I had it like a sinus deal and I I blew my nose and a BB came out little round ball with a flat side on it.

link.reason: No story covers Barth blowing a metal BB out of his nose.

candidates.title: Robert Hastings' nasal implant and blood on pillow
candidates.quote: wrote UFOs and Nukes is actually a UFO experiencer and he wrote a book about this called Confessions >> and he talks about an implant in his nose and then waking up with uh blood on his pillow.

link.reason: The nearest story describes Hastings's book Confessions as a whole. This telling is one specific episode from it, the nasal implant and blood on his pillow.

candidates.title: Blood on pillow after 1988 camping trip
candidates.quote: his pillow. You did mention after the camping trip in 1988 you waking up with blood on your pillow,

link.reason: This is Barth's own blood on his pillow after a 1988 camping trip, a different person and event from Hastings's account in telling 9.

candidates.title: Being on the porch apologises: needed access to the site
candidates.place_text: Minuteman missile site D5, Vandenberg Air Force Base, California
candidates.quote: but we had had to have access to the site.

link.reason: The being's apology for needing access to the site is part of Barth's 1964 encounter with the humanoid at Minuteman site D5, Vandenberg.
link.difference: Adds that the being apologised and explained that it needed access to the site.

candidates.title: Hard object found in nostril during 2001 nasal surgery
candidates.quote: Well, uh, in 2001, I believe it was, um, I was having breathing problems. I had a deviated septum. So, I finally had some nasal surgery.

link.reason: A hard object found during nasal surgery in 2001 is a different event from the BB Barth blew out of his nose in 1964.

candidates.title: Chrome-plated BB-like object spat out of nose, possibly an implant
candidates.quote: It was the only thing it wasn't a copper BB. It was it was uh like chrome plated or something.

link.reason: The same small metal ball, described as a BB, that came out of the witness's nose, now framed as a possible implant.
link.difference: Describes it as chrome-plated rather than copper, puts it years after childhood and suggests it was an implant.

candidates.title: Abduction too vivid to be trickery: terror and love
candidates.quote: no. It was too too vivid, too real. Nobody could do what was done to me.

link.reason: Richard's insistence that his abduction at Vandenberg was too vivid to be faked refers to the same 1964 humanoid abduction.
link.difference: Adds his feelings of terror and love and his denial that anyone could have staged it.

candidates.title: Beings conditioned him not to tell anyone at Vandenberg
candidates.quote: it was like I was told not to and not, you know, the beings had conditioned me or hypnotized me or something.

link.reason: The beings conditioning him to keep silent belongs to the same Vandenberg abduction.
link.difference: Adds that the beings hypnotised or conditioned him not to tell anyone at the base.

candidates.title: Beings will not let humanity go to nuclear war
candidates.years_text: time of Richard's encounter to present
candidates.quote: they'll leave us alone unless we uh I mean, this is the sense I got that they would leave us alone unless we screwed up.

link.reason: The same message from Richard's encounter: the beings will not allow nuclear war.
link.difference: Adds that they would leave humanity alone unless we 'screwed up'.

candidates.title: Writing to Bob Lazar about his experience
candidates.quote: when I when I wrote uh Bob Salazar. I'm not in this for anything.

link.reason: Richard writing to Bob Lazar about his experience is unrelated to the stories about Lazar below, such as Rogan's proposal or Aaron Paul's messages.

candidates.title: Hastings' book has 169 accounts, only eight close encounters of the third kind
candidates.quote: Robert Hastings's book's got like 169 accounts in it.

link.reason: The same claim that only about seven or eight of Hastings's roughly 167 nuclear-site witnesses had close encounters of the third kind.
link.difference: Gives 169 accounts and eight close encounters, and credits the book rather than a conversation with Hastings.

candidates.title: Hastings did not systematically ask witnesses whether they saw beings
candidates.quote: this conversation with Bob Hastings in the past where I say, "Did you did you systematically ask all of the whistleblowers who just seen crafts whether they've seen beings themselves?" And he said, "No."

link.reason: This is the same conversation between Jesse and Hastings about how many witnesses saw beings, but here Hastings says he never asked them systematically instead of giving a count.
link.difference: Hastings answers that he did not systematically ask witnesses about beings, rather than giving the figure of seven or eight.

candidates.title: Call to Art Bell show and emails with an author who couldn't corroborate his account
candidates.place_text: Coast to Coast AM radio / email
candidates.quote: he couldn't include me any further books because he couldn't collaborate it,

link.reason: Richard's call to Art Bell's show and his emails with an author are not covered by the Art Bell stories below, which are about Roswell material, a transmission failure and the Mitchell–Hoagland debate.

candidates.title: Calling George Noory's show while Bob Hastings was the guest
candidates.quote: Hastings was one I had talked to when I called George Dory

link.reason: Richard's own call to George Noory's radio show while Hastings was the guest; no story below is about this call.

candidates.title: Vandenberg incident the same month, corroborated by Mansmann and Jacobs
candidates.quote: that was corroborated by Floren's Mansman who is the major who is in charge in supervising Bob Jacobs who's a photo instrumentation specialist.

link.reason: The Vandenberg incident vouched for by Mansmann and Jacobs is the 1964 dummy warhead UFO story.
link.difference: Dates it only as the same month as Richard's experience, and leans on Mansmann's supervisory role as corroboration.

candidates.title: Vandenberg Red Square
candidates.quote: The incursions began on October 14th, 2003 when Boeing contractors reported a massive glowing red square silently hovering over two missile defense sites.
documents: Official Air Force records of the event

link.reason: A large glowing rectangular or square object at Vandenberg in 2003, matching Shurmer's football-sized rectangle; the five-incident story is a broader series.
link.difference: Gives the date as October 14, 2003, says it was red, glowing and silent over two missile defence sites, says Boeing contractors reported it, and cites Air Force records, AARO and the FBI.

candidates.title: Football-field-sized triangle over entry control point at Vandenberg
candidates.quote: When I arrived on scene, I talked to five shaken witnesses who described a massive triangular craft larger than a football field that hovered silently for about 45 seconds over their entry control point before shooting away at impossible speed.

link.reason: Nuccetelli's large triangle hovering over Vandenberg is the big black triangle story that Matthew Brown relays from him.
link.difference: Told first-hand, dated October 14, 2003, hovering about 45 seconds over the entry control point (not the runway) with five witnesses, then leaving at great speed.

candidates.title: Vandenberg and Malmstrom as recurring UFO hotspots
candidates.place_text: Vandenberg AFB, California; Malmstrom AFB, Montana
candidates.quote: It's one of these places like Malmstrom uh you know base in Montana where throughout the years you have recurring patterns of UFO sightings.

link.reason: A general claim that Vandenberg and Malmstrom are recurring hotspots, not any single incident in the stories.

candidates.title: Hynek at Project Blue Book, opposed then repented
candidates.quote: you have Jaylen Heinik who was opposed but then you know later retracted all of that stuff and kind of repented for the fact that he was opposed.

link.reason: Hynek's turn from Blue Book debunker to admitting he took part in the cover-up matches the story where he says he played a part in it.

downgraded.why: a program telling and the testimony story hynek-says-he-played-a-part-in-the-blue-book-cover-up-1960: a program and a story of another kind are different grains

candidates.title: Donald Menzel, cleared insider dogmatically opposed to UFOs
candidates.quote: So you have Don Menzel who's you know this kind of deep state spook you know friends with Vanavar Bush held all the clearances in the book.

link.reason: Menzel as a debunker holding the highest clearances matches the story about Menzel's clearances.
link.difference: Adds his friendship with Vannevar Bush and calls him a 'deep state spook'; leaves out JFK.

candidates.title: Condon Report and its links to atomic secrecy
candidates.quote: And then you find out that he was, you know, very close friends with Oenheimer going back to, you know, their studies at Gotten in Germany in the 20s.

link.reason: Condon as an atomic insider, tied to Oppenheimer since Göttingen, who later debunked UFOs is the Condon story.

candidates.quote: it's probably just this fake hit job on UFOs, is a guy named Sean Kirkpatre, who, you know, has long ties with the DOE, worked at Oakidge,
